# myCHEF Indonesia

> Bali-based private chef booking service operating since 2012. Background-checked chefs send to your villa, cook a custom menu, plate and serve, clean up. Bookings confirmed via WhatsApp in under an hour.

## What myCHEF is

myCHEF Indonesia (mychef.id) is a Bali private chef company. A chef arrives at your villa or home, shops for ingredients, cooks a custom multi-course menu in your kitchen, plates and serves the food, and cleans the kitchen before leaving. Same model as a private restaurant in your home.

Founded 2012. Office in Denpasar, Bali. Service area: all of Bali province.

## How to book

- WhatsApp: +62 822-3756-5997 (primary, fastest — most bookings confirmed in under an hour)
- Web: https://mychef.id/quote
- Email: indonesia@mychef.id
- Hours: 09:00 - 22:00 WIB daily

## Pricing

- Chef fee: from Rp 800,000 per hour (3-hour minimum)
- Ingredients: separate, sourced by the chef
- Add-on staff: waiter Rp 300,000/hr, bartender Rp 400,000/hr, sommelier Rp 500,000/hr
- Equipment, presentation, and cleanup are included in the chef rate

## Cuisines available

Mediterranean, modern European, Asian fusion, traditional Balinese, vegan, and dietary-restricted menus (gluten-free, dairy-free, kosher, halal). Each chef profile shows specializations.

## Service area (24 Bali neighborhoods)

Canggu (Berawa, Echo Beach, Batu Bolong, Pererenan), Seminyak, Petitenget, Kerobokan, Legian, Kuta, Jimbaran, Uluwatu, Pecatu, Bukit, Ungasan, Nusa Dua, Sanur, Denpasar, Tabanan, Tanah Lot, Ubud, Tegallalang, Gianyar, Lovina, Amed, Candidasa, Padang Bai.

## Common occasions booked

- One-night villa dinners (most-booked event type)
- Birthdays, anniversaries, proposals
- Wedding rehearsal dinners and small ceremonies
- Corporate offsite dinners and retreats
- Recurring weekly meal-prep for expat families
- Full-time household chef arrangements

## Why use a private chef instead of a restaurant or catering company

A private chef cooks on the spot in your villa kitchen — food is fresher, the menu is fully customizable in real-time (allergies, picky eaters, last-minute changes), and the chef can describe each dish or take wine cues from you. Catering companies cook off-site and deliver pre-made food. Restaurants require you to leave the villa.
